name: Canva
description: Canva is an online visual design platform letting non-designers create graphics, documents, presentations, videos, and print materials from templates.
best_for: Positioned for general users and teams who want to create marketing and visual content without dedicated design skills.
features: Templates for social media, presentations, documents, and print
AI-assisted tools including image generation and layout suggestions
Photo and video editing with background removal

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.description: A browser- and desktop-based design tool for interface design, prototyping, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Product teams doing UI design and prototyping

alternatives.name: Sketch
alternatives.description: A vector-based UI/UX design application for creating interface designs and interactive prototypes, macOS only.
